description: Every countable family of functions from naturals to naturals has a common strict eventual bound. For the empty family, the bound may be the constant zero function.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FiniteErrors.countable_eventual_bound (F : Set (ℕ → ℕ)) (hF : F.Countable) :
  ∃ g, (F = ∅ → g = fun x => 0) ∧ ∀ f ∈ F, Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FiniteErrors.EventuallyLT f g
